rationale: Setup at ss 100C 1.60V is the only binding limit: hold (>= +0.08 ns), slew/cap (<= 18 vs bar 89) and DRC (0) never bind; tight runs are limited reg-to-reg, not at ports. period_frac is at its 0.45 floor, so gains must come from repair over-achieving. In the best run (AREA 3, cap213) signoff slack (+0.33) beat the 0.2 placement margin by ~0.13, as in md5 (0.18 -> 0.30): slack tracks margin. DELAY 3 was worse. Setting 1: best run with both setup margins at 0.4, isolating margin. Setting 2: same plus a smaller, denser die (util 38, density 50%) to shorten critical-path wires, using unused routing headroom (wirelength ~7% over estimate, DRC converges).
